motion.name: navigation-state
motion.value: color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease

components.name: Research submit
components.description: Primary composer action extracted from src/research/home.css.
components.css: .ds-research-submit { min-height: var(--control-height, 32px); padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 2px); background: var(--accent, #c7b58e); color: var(--bg, #030705); font: var(--text-ui, 13px)/var(--leading-ui, 1.45) var(--font-ui, system-ui); cursor: pointer; } .ds-research-submit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #d8c69f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-research-submit:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: New conversation
components.description: Raised secondary action extracted from src/research/home.css.
components.css: .ds-research-new { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: var(--control-height, 32px); padding: 11px 12px; background: var(--surface-raised, #0b130f); color: var(--ink, #e7e7da); border: 1px solid var(--control-border, #637c70); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 2px); text-align: left; font: var(--text-ui, 13px)/var(--leading-ui, 1.45) var(--font-ui, system-ui); cursor: pointer; } .ds-research-new:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #d8c69f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Research field
components.description: Research Home field extracted from src/research/home.css and shared focus styles.
components.html: <input class="ds-research-field" aria-label="Find a saved study" placeholder="Find a saved study" />
components.css: .ds-research-field { min-width: 0; max-width: 100%; min-height: var(--control-height, 32px); padding: 7px; background: var(--surface-raised, #0b130f); color: var(--ink, #e7e7da); border: 1px solid var(--control-border, #637c70); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 2px); font: var(--text-ui, 13px)/var(--leading-ui, 1.45) var(--font-ui, system-ui); caret-color: var(--ink, #e7e7da); } .ds-research-field::placeholder { color: var(--faint, #8fa597); opacity: 1; } .ds-research-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #d8c69f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ask chip
components.css: .ds-ask-chip { min-height: var(--control-height, 32px); padding: 3px 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #e7e7da); border: 1px solid var(--line, #233129); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 2px); font: var(--text-meta, 12px)/1.35 var(--font-ui, system-ui); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ask-chip:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--amber, #d8b77a); color: var(--amber, #d8b77a); } .ds-ask-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--amber, #d8b77a); background: var(--amber, #d8b77a); color: #07090c; } .ds-ask-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #d8c69f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-ask-chip:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; }

components.name: Research composer container
components.description: Composer boundary extracted from src/research/home.css; content here is a preview label.
components.css: .ds-research-composer { padding: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--control-border, #637c70); border-radius: var(--radius-panel, 3px); background: var(--panel, #060c08); color: var(--ink, #e7e7da); font: var(--text-ui, 13px)/var(--leading-ui, 1.45) var(--font-ui, system-ui); } .ds-research-composer:focus-within { border-color: var(--focus, #d8c69f); } .ds-research-composer input { display: block; min-height: var(--control-height, 32px); padding: 7px; background: var(--surface-raised, #0b130f); color: var(--ink, #e7e7da); border: 1px solid var(--control-border, #637c70); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 2px); font: inherit; } .ds-research-composer input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #d8c69f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destination label states
components.description: Text and boundary states extracted from src/styles.css and src/design/terminalTheme.css; destination icon pigments are documented separately.
components.css: .ds-navigation { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; background: var(--bg, #030705); } .ds-navigation button { min-height: var(--control-height, 32px); padding: 6px 9px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--dim, #b0bdb3); font: var(--text-ui, 13px)/var(--leading-ui, 1.45) var(--font-ui, system-ui); letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; } .ds-navigation button[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--ink, #e7e7da); border-bottom-color: var(--accent, #c7b58e); background: var(--surface-raised, #0b130f); } .ds-navigation button:hover { color: var(--ink, #e7e7da); background: var(--surface-hover, #101c15); } .ds-navigation button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #d8c69f); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-navigation button { transition-duration: 0.01ms; } }

narrative.overview: This is an extraction of the implemented terminal, not a replacement identity. The user's established direction is a matte near-black surface with a green cast, bright useful navigation icons, and system typography. The interface favors dense inspection, readable values, and visible provenance.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, quiet terminal surfaces with fine boundaries.
Bright destination icons against restrained labels and controls.
System sans-serif text, technical monospace, and aligned numeric columns.
Evidence, assumptions, and coverage limits remain close to results.
dos: Do preserve matte near-black green terminal surfaces.
Do preserve bright navigation icons and existing semantic color mappings.
Do reuse shared system typography, spacing, focus, and numeric alignment.
Do keep values, provenance, and material limitations readable together.
donts: Don't add a gradient to the terminal surface.
Don't use decorative color changes to imply new data meaning.
Don't replace accessible labels or selected-state markers with color alone.
Don't promote one figure's composition, palette, or breakpoint into a global requirement.
